edits.new: Custom aggregation.pipeline stages must work with the selected partitioner; the current docs state that aggregation stages such as $group do not work with any partitioner that creates more than one partition. The AutoBucketPartitioner implementation uses the $match stage of the user's pipeline (only if the user's first stage is a $match) when calculating bucket bounds, then appends the configured user pipeline to each generated partition pipeline. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/spark-connector/current/batch-mode/batch-read-config.md ; https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo-spark/main/src/main/java/com/mongodb/spark/sql/connector/read/partitioner/AutoBucketPartitioner.java

edits.rationale: The $group warning is in the current docs. In the AutoBucketPartitioner source, the bounds-calculation pipeline reuses the user's $match only if it is the first stage of the user pipeline; it is not an unconditional initial $match. The user pipeline is appended to every partition pipeline via addAll.
